title: 🧭 Permissioned Night-Shoot Planner
description: A hard-stop preflight for spooky video shoots. It is designed for a controlled set, booked attraction or explicitly permitted property—not abandoned, closed or restricted buildings. No address or l...

inputs.name: snsp-permission
inputs.label: Owner, manager or venue has explicitly authorized this exact area and time.

inputs.name: snsp-inspected
inputs.label: Daylight walk-through completed; floors, stairs and access are stable and known. Unknown hazards mean no entry.

inputs.name: snsp-exits
inputs.label: Exit routes are unlocked, usable and kept clear; nobody will climb, crawl or go alone into a dark area.

inputs.name: snsp-buddy
inputs.label: A buddy stays with the crew; someone outside the shot knows the plan and check-in time.

inputs.name: snsp-kit
inputs.label: Working flashlight, charged phone, spare power and basic first aid are on hand.

inputs.name: snsp-travel
inputs.label: Weather and the trip home are checked; the driver is rested and sober.

inputs.name: snsp-consent
inputs.label: Everyone on camera has opted into the planned horror effects and can stop the take at any time.

inputs.name: snsp-effects
inputs.label: No open flames, weapons, smoke, surprise blasts, or effects that could make someone run or fall.

inputs.name: snsp-site
inputs.label: What kind of authorized set is this?

formula: Interactive browser tool — no single closed-form formula (see description).
